summary.headline: Fixed Stars and Their Effects
summary.text: Astrological exposition of fixed stars, giving their longitudes, latitudes, winds, and temperaments according to Ptolemy, followed by natal effects when Spica, Lyra, the Great Fish, the Bird, or the Northern Crown rises; Mars’s aspect is introduced at the end.
